sources.entry: liuchong/awesome-roadmaps: A curated list of roadmaps.

summary.one_liner: A curated, link-only list of learning roadmaps and study paths, mostly for software development, with some AI, infrastructure, security, and hardware topics.
summary.what_it_does: The README is an "awesome" style list of links organized by category: Programming Language, Web Development, Mobile Development, Infrastructure/Operations, Game Development, AI/ML/Data Science, Security, Miscellaneous, Tools & Resources, and Articles & Books. Each entry is a one-line description of a roadmap, course, handbook, or article, such as language-specific developer roadmaps, a 12-week AI curriculum, and Anthropic engineering articles on agents. It does not contain roadmap content itself; it points to external resources. Contributions are accepted via pull requests or issues. The README's License section is empty.
use_cases: Find a learning path for a programming language or framework
Pick a career roadmap for DevOps, cloud, or data roles
Locate beginner AI or LLM agent courses
Browse study plans for cybersecurity or embedded systems
Compare frontend or Android learning resources
Find articles on system design or software architecture
notable: Covers many domains, from web and mobile to FPGA/ASIC, mathematics, and UI/UX design
Includes a dedicated AI agents section with several agent-focused roadmaps and articles
Entries mix visual roadmaps, full courses, PDFs, books, and blog articles
Links to upstream resources and notes that year badges reflect the latest year shown by each resource
caveats: Link list only; the linked resources vary in quality, format, and currency, and some are described as archived
The README's License section is blank, so the license of the list itself is not stated
Some entries are third-party or commercial services, such as TutorialSearch, and their terms are not described here
